title: A non-vanishing property for tensor products of wavelets
summary: We prove that, given a wavelet $ψ$, it is possible to choose some multi-integers $(p_j=(p_{j,1},...,p_{j,d}))_{j \in \mathbb{Z}} \in \mathbb{Z}^d$ such that, for every $x=(x_1,...,x_d) \in \mathbb{R}^d$, for infinitely many integers $j$, the tensorized wavelet $\prod_{i=1}^d ψ(2^j x_i-p_{j,i})$ does not vanish at $x$. This non-vanishing property is essential for analyzing some generic regularity properties in certain Sobolev and Besov spaces. The proof relies on an assumption regarding the zeros of $ψ$, which we numerically verify for the first Daubechies wavelets.
